observed_facts: defaultEnabled is supported in plugin.json and marketplace entries
plugin agents support tools, disallowedTools, model, maxTurns, skills, memory, effort, background, isolation, color, and initialPrompt
plugin agents ignore hooks, mcpServers, and permissionMode
isolation=worktree creates an isolated temporary git worktree
PostToolBatch fires once after a parallel tool batch and does not support matchers
SessionStart matchers are startup, resume, clear, and compact
project-scope plugins do not load background monitors
plugin settings.json currently supports only agent and subagentStatusLine
plugin userConfig is read from user, managed, or --settings sources rather than project pluginConfigs
LSP dispatch maps file extensions to language identifiers and has no bounded path matcher

claude-code-config-lsp.reconciliation_note: The LSP remains useful for diagnostics, completion, hover, semantic tokens, Declare traces, and CLI conformance. Its ontology and executable behavior do not yet model every current loader surface. It must not own every JSON, Markdown, TOML, and shell file through the main Chatman plugin.

known_deltas.current_loader: version is optional; omitted versions use the git commit SHA
owner is an object with required name and optional email

known_deltas.lsp_model: source is an HTTPS string or local:path
known_deltas.current_loader: source is a relative path string or typed github, url, git-subdir, or npm object

known_deltas.lsp_model: skills and agents are arrays; hooks and MCP are inline objects
known_deltas.current_loader: skills, commands, agents, hooks, MCP, and LSP components accept string, array, or object forms as applicable

known_deltas.lsp_model: lspServers is an array containing name fields
known_deltas.current_loader: lspServers is a map from server name to configuration or a path to .lsp.json
extensionToLanguage dispatch has no repository-path predicate
known_deltas.note: The standalone config LSP may be installed explicitly. The main Chatman plugin cannot lawfully claim common extensions globally.

known_deltas.current_loader: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt, and experimental agent hooks across the current lifecycle event set
known_deltas.note: PostToolBatch, ConfigChange, WorktreeCreate, and WorktreeRemove are used by v26.7.29. SessionStart remains bounded to startup, resume, clear, and compact.

known_deltas.current_loader: plugin agents support tools, disallowedTools, maxTurns, skills, memory, effort, background, isolation, color, and initialPrompt
known_deltas.note: Plugin agents ignore hooks, mcpServers, and permissionMode. v26.7.29 uses only loader-supported mechanical authority fields.

known_deltas.current_loader: dependencies support optional semver and cross-marketplace policy
experimental.monitors and experimental.themes; legacy top-level forms warn
known_deltas.note: Project-scope plugins do not load monitors. Personal-scope monitor activation can be bounded with on-skill-invoke.

known_deltas.current_loader: userConfig and channels are supported manifest surfaces
known_deltas.note: Current pluginConfigs are sourced from user, managed, or --settings sources. Project pluginConfigs are ignored.

known_deltas.current_loader: plugin settings.json accepts only agent and subagentStatusLine
plugin agents and skills live at agents/ and skills/ under the plugin root

federated_conformance_law.plugin-load: claude plugin validate must pass on the exact release surface
federated_conformance_law.modeled-editor-surfaces: bounded claude-code-config-lsp diagnostics and Declare traces must be recorded when available
federated_conformance_law.known-epoch-delta: an LSP diagnostic matching a declared delta cannot alone refuse current loader conformance
federated_conformance_law.ownership: loader validity cannot override generated-artifact ownership drift
federated_conformance_law.phase-advance: conformance=conformant requires loader validation plus no unresolved non-epoch modeled error and no ownership refusal
federated_conformance_law.claim-separation: loader validity does not prove semantic correctness; modeled conformance does not prove runtime loadability outside its epoch
